title: TMRL: Diffusion Timestep-Modulated Pretraining Enables Exploration for Efficient Policy Finetuning
abstract: arXiv:2605.12236v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained robot policies with reinforcement learning (RL) often inherits the bottlenecks introduced by pre-training with behavioral cloning (BC), which produces narrow action distributions that lack the coverage necessary for downstream exploration. We present a unified framework that enables the exploration necessary to enable efficient robot policy finetuning by bridging BC pre-training and RL fine-tuning. Our pre-training method, Context-Smoothed Pre-training (CSP), injects forward-diffusion noise into policy inputs, creating a continuum between precise imitation and broad action coverage. We then fine-tune pre-trained policies via Timestep-Modulated Reinforcement Learning (TMRL), which trains the agent to dynamically adjust this conditioning during fine-tuning by modulating the diffusion timestep, granting explicit control over exploration. Integrating seamlessly with arbitrary policy inputs, e.g., states, 3D

translated_title: TMRL：扩散时间步调制预训练赋能高效策略微调的探索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.12236v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：使用强化学习（RL）微调预训练机器人策略通常会继承行为克隆（BC）预训练引入的瓶颈，这会产生狭窄的动作分布，缺乏下游探索所需的覆盖范围。我们提出了一个统一框架，通过桥接BC预训练和RL微调，实现高效机器人策略微调所需的探索。我们的预训练方法，上下文平滑预训练（CSP），将前向扩散噪声注入策略输入，在精确模仿和广泛动作覆盖之间创建连续体。然后，我们通过时间步调制强化学习（TMRL）微调预训练策略，该算法训练代理在微调期间通过调制扩散时间步动态调整这种条件，从而实现对探索的显式控制。该方法可与任意策略输入（例如状态、3D数据）无缝集成。
tldr: 本文提出一种统一框架，通过上下文平滑预训练注入扩散噪声和强化学习微调调制扩散时间步，解决了行为克隆预训练导致探索不足的问题，实现了高效机器人策略微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework that injects diffusion noise via context-smoothed pretraining and modulates diffusion timesteps during reinforcement learning fine-tuning, addressing the exploration bottleneck from behavioral cloning pretraining for efficient robot policy fine-tuning.
